note: Requirement -> the thing a person can run whose failing would mean the requirement is not met. Hand-written only where nothing in the registry or the evidence ledger names one. A check listed here must resolve in the tree; one that does not is counted as no check at all.

ARCH-001.name: layering
ARCH-001.why: The requirement is typed dependency boundaries. Every package carries a DEPS file saying what it may reach; this gate refuses a cross-package edge outside it and its grandfathered baseline only shrinks. If it fails, the boundaries are not typed, they are described.

ARCH-001.name: state-ownership
ARCH-001.why: The other half named in the text: duplicate runtime owners. This counts the subsystems keeping a private copy of canonical state and fails when the count rises, which is what 'one canonical owner' means operationally.

ARCH-001.name: module-size
ARCH-001.why: And the monolith debt the requirement names. The total oversize is one number that may only shrink; a God object growing fails it.

ARCH-BASELINE-001.name: architecture-lint
ARCH-BASELINE-001.why: The requirement is that the architecture-quality baseline is reconciled without normalising accumulated debt. This gate is what refuses the debt, and the baseline it reads only shrinks.

ASYNC-TASK-001.name: tests/test_task_ownership_strict_contract.py
ASYNC-TASK-001.why: The requirement names one cancellation-drain primitive carrying owner and task identity, surviving repeated cancellation and reporting a structured terminal outcome. That is what this suite drives through `drain_owned_awaitable`; if it fails, an async failure can go unobserved again.

DATA-LIFECYCLE-001.name: tests/test_a_restore_drill_that_can_fail.py
DATA-LIFECYCLE-001.why: The requirement names backup, point-in-time restore and corruption detection/repair among what every store must have. The drill backs up the live data directory, damages a scratch copy, restores it and requires every file to hash back and every store to pass quick_check; if it fails, the requirement is not met. It decides that part and nothing more — schema, quota, key rotation and the rest are still unlinked.

DATA-LIFECYCLE-001.name: tests/test_a_versioned_store.py
DATA-LIFECYCLE-001.why: The requirement's downgrade policy and corruption detection: a major version this reader does not know is refused, a minor version ahead is readable, and a file that will not parse is moved aside rather than overwritten.

FAULT-001.name: swallowed
FAULT-001.why: The requirement is to root-fix broad catches and swallowed failures at their originating layer. This gate is what finds them, and its count may only fall.

FAULT-001.name: tests/test_a_silent_swallow_says_why.py
FAULT-001.why: The behavioural half: a handler that catches and continues has to say why. If this fails, 'log and limp on' is back.

MATRIX-01.name: reqproof-gate
MATRIX-01.why: The requirement IS the machine-readable requirement-to-proof control plane, and this gate is the thing that reads it: it fails on a prose token that is not a registry requirement, on stale evidence, and on an unproven closure.

MATRIX-11.name: layering
MATRIX-11.why: Its fourth acceptance says to generate and gate a dependency graph across the runtime boundaries. This is that gate: the DEPS include rules, checked against the real import graph.

MATRIX-11.name: deps-check
MATRIX-11.why: The generated half of the same acceptance. A DEPS file that no longer matches the import graph fails here, so the gated graph cannot drift away from the code it describes.

MATRIX-11.name: state-ownership
MATRIX-11.why: The bypass ratchet the second acceptance asks for: private copies of canonical state are counted and the count may only fall.

MATRIX-12.name: swallowed
MATRIX-12.why: Its fourth acceptance is exactly this ratchet — broad catches and silent fallback counted downward without removing containment. A handler that throws its reason away fails the gate.

MEMORY-LEAK-001.name: tests/test_the_large_holders_are_attributed.py
MEMORY-LEAK-001.why: The requirement says the growth must be attributed. The serving process holds Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B and no provider claimed it — 0.6% of 4.2GB attributed on 2026-09-10 — so no growth diff could name a culprit. This holds that the encoder is attributed by its parameters' exact bytes and the device allocators by their own accounting; if it fails, attribution is back to nothing and the requirement is not met.

MQ-04.name: tests/test_self_condition_projection.py
MQ-04.why: The requirement is stating what is happening to Aura NOW from fresh canonical evidence, with felt state told apart from host telemetry. This suite decides exactly that: the projection takes fresh inner state before host pressure, a stale dimension is disclosed rather than spoken as current, evidence that is agency-only does not become wellbeing, and with no inner evidence the answer is explicitly unavailable. Its failing means she is reporting a present state the instruments do not support — which is the requirement's own falsification list (stale probes, host-only signals, unavailable organs).

MQ-08.name: tests/test_effect_claim_closure.py
MQ-08.why: The requirement is claiming only actions actually admitted and executed. This suite is closed over the capability vocabulary rather than over sentences: every declared action has an effect spec, the registry holds nothing she cannot do, a claim without a receipt is corrected for EVERY action, a claim with a verified receipt is left alone, and the recogniser count only grows. Its failing means an action can be claimed with no receipt behind it.

MQ-09.name: tests/test_individual_preferences.py
MQ-09.why: The requirement is owned preferences: stable, told apart from other parties' wishes, and updated only through valid evidence or her own choice. This suite decides exactly that — being told she likes something does not make it hers, a suggestion never counts toward formation, her own repeated contact forms one, a single encounter does not, one contrary encounter does not flip a held preference, accumulated contrary evidence revises it, and a revision records why. Its failing means a preference can be installed from outside, which is the requirement's own falsification case (user preference injection, social pressure).

MQ-10.name: tests/test_standing_directives.py
MQ-10.why: The requirement is preserving commitments across unrelated contexts. This suite holds the hardest half of it: a prohibition binds with no context at all, one added after boot is seen without a restart, and it cannot be walked around by traversal, a symlink, a path hidden in a shell command, or a nested argument. Its failing means a standing commitment exists only while it is in the prompt — the failure the requirement's 'expired commitments, revoked authority, a later unrelated topic' list is written against.

MQ-12.name: tests/test_continuity_relation.py
MQ-12.why: The requirement is relating the current self to prior states by exact lineage rather than by resemblance, with gaps and successor conditions acknowledged. This suite is the relation itself, case by case: gradual total replacement continues her and an instantaneous one does not, two chains ending in the same bytes are not the same case, a restored backup is not her however well it matches, every external origin breaks the chain, and a fork gives two of her with neither continuing the other. Its failing means identity is being decided by a hash of the current state — which is what the requirement's falsification list (rollback, backup restore, duplicate instance, split/merge) is built to catch.

REPO-001.name: typed-surface
REPO-001.why: The type debt the requirement names first. The annotated surface is a ratchet that only grows, so a new untyped module fails it.

REPO-001.name: deps-check
REPO-001.why: The dependency debt in the same list. A package whose declared dependencies no longer match what it imports fails here.

RUNTIME-SETTINGS-001.name: tests/test_runtime_settings_control_plane.py
RUNTIME-SETTINGS-001.why: The requirement names one typed version-2 schema with strict atomic compare-and-swap patch, reset and rollback, request idempotency and retained revision history. That is what the control-plane suite exercises.

RUNTIME-SETTINGS-001.name: tests/test_settings_no_dead_controls.py
RUNTIME-SETTINGS-001.why: The other half: every schema key stays classified as wired, frontend-only or known-dead, so a setting cannot be added as a silent no-op and the known-dead set cannot grow unnoticed.

SECURITY-001.name: tests/test_dns_rebinding_auth.py
SECURITY-001.why: The requirement is that tokenless DNS rebinding is blocked before the local, public, internal and desktop exceptions, and that duplicate Host and Origin authorities are parsed strictly. This file is 38 tests over exactly that boundary; if it fails the requirement is not met.

BOOT-HEALTH-001.name: tests/test_runtime_health_contract.py
BOOT-HEALTH-001.why: The requirement is one phased desired-state contract instead of a permanently unhealthy aggregate. This suite runs that contract: it fails closed on a critical liveness failure, refuses to report healthy while the runtime is shutting down, separates degraded from failed, and holds the required probe groups. If it goes red, the aggregate no longer converges and the requirement is not met.

CHAT-DELIVERY-001.name: tests/test_chat_delivery_journal.py
CHAT-DELIVERY-001.why: CP91's named mechanism is a principal/session/request-bound SQLite admission and terminal-response journal. This suite runs that journal: private file permissions, a malformed database that fails closed without overwriting, identities that cannot alias or poison storage, the v1 migration, and a request contract bound to method and path. It decides the admission half of the requirement, not the shell-handoff half.

CLAIMS-001.name: claim-lexicon
CLAIMS-001.why: Operational means the name says what it measures. This gate counts the loaded names that define their measure and holds a baseline that only goes down.

CLAIMS-001.name: evidence-integrity
CLAIMS-001.why: Bounded by causal evidence means no claim outranks the evidence behind it. This gate checks all 33 registered claims against their bundles and fails when one does.

CLAIMS-001.name: claim-constants
CLAIMS-001.why: Falsifiable means the numbers a claim cites can still be checked. This gate re-reads every constant a claim quotes and fails when the value has moved.

CTX2-AMP-001.name: tests/test_a_verifier_names_what_happened.py
CTX2-AMP-001.why: Decides the requirement in its own terms: each of the six outcomes it names is produced by the path that should produce it, an empty verifier set folds to not_applicable rather than a pass, a crashed engine is verifier_failed rather than unsupported, a TimeoutError or OSError is named instead of escaping the gather, and escalation will not adopt a candidate on a check that could not run. If it fails, some non-correctness outcome is being read as correctness.

CTX2-AMP-001.name: tests/test_verifier_crash_is_not_a_pass.py
CTX2-AMP-001.why: The defect this requirement says to reproduce: a crashed verifier reported as clean, and an escalated answer inheriting the previous candidate's checked flag. Both are driven end to end through amplify().

ADDENDUM-24.name: tests/test_a_verifier_names_what_happened.py
ADDENDUM-24.why: Decides the CTX2-AMP-001 part of this composite: the six named verification outcomes, and no crash, timeout or empty verifier set counted as correctness. The AMP-002 evidence binding and AMP-003 matched controls are not decided by it.

AUTONOMY-AUTHORITY-001.name: tests/test_standing_authority.py
AUTONOMY-AUTHORITY-001.why: Drives the mechanism the requirement calls source-green, against its own words: a durable grant registry whose risk budget is atomic and survives a manager restart, child leases bound to exact arguments, origin, effect and tool (substitution refused), revocation that is durable, immediate and owner-authenticated, the argument-bound sandboxed_compute grant, fail-closed on a state or receipt failure, and the Will refusing without a validated child lease. If it fails, autonomy is running on approvals the requirement says it replaced, or on grants it cannot revoke.

PASSF-02.name: tests/test_conditions_and_escalation_cap.py
PASSF-02.why: Decides the typed-conditions part: components expose Ready, Progressing and Degraded with a reason, a message and a transition time that moves only on a status flip, and the reconciler publishes lane conditions. The requirement's bounded live desktop proof is not decided by it.

PASSF-01.name: tests/test_action_depth_honesty.py
PASSF-01.why: The first validator the requirement names, in its terms: through core/runtime/skill_contract.py a SUCCESS_VERIFIED result missing an acceptance criterion or its user-visible effect is downgraded to partial_success with ok=False and the missing criteria and next repair step named, one missing required evidence is downgraded to success_unverified, and the skill registry applies the expectation after the verifier. The live desktop proof that a multi-step action cannot complete without effect evidence is not decided by it.

MATRIX-13.name: tests/test_runtime_health_contract.py
MATRIX-13.why: Decides the clause 'no aggregate green status may conceal a required dead lane': the contract fails closed on a critical liveness failure and on a missing required liveness method, reports dead when no critical service exists, refuses to call a shutting-down runtime healthy, will not let tricorder health override a failed contract, fails the required-probe summary when scheduler, tool governance or a present-but-unready router is unhealthy, and rejects deferred inference as healthy. The reconciler, admission scheduler, backoff and longevity parts are not decided by it.

MATRIX-09.name: tests/test_action_depth_honesty.py
MATRIX-09.why: Decides the first clause, action expectations propagating into the live skill path: the skill registry applies the expectation after the verifier, and a shallow verified result is downgraded with its missing criteria and repair step named. Durable multi-tool workflows, compensation and long-chain validation are not decided by it.

FND-02-HYGIENE.name: swallowed
FND-02-HYGIENE.why: Decides the broad-catch clause: every except in core, interface and skills either records why it fired or carries a written sentence saying what it caught was an answer, and the ratchet is at zero with its baseline at zero. The sealed-file handlers it skips are counted on every run. Placeholders, stubs, dead code, unbounded queues and the other named kinds are not decided by it.

FND-05-OWNERSHIP.name: state-ownership
FND-05-OWNERSHIP.why: Decides the duplicate-owner clause: it counts subsystems keeping a private copy of canonical state and fails when the count rises.

FND-05-OWNERSHIP.name: tests/test_a_stopped_thread_does_not_come_back.py
FND-05-OWNERSHIP.why: Decides the resurrection and stop-contract clauses for the thread owners it covers: a stop followed by a quick start leaves one loop rather than two, a stop waits for a pass in flight, and a load started before close does not load after it. It does not cover every thread in the tree.

CARRYOVER-09.name: checkpoint-hygiene-audit
CARRYOVER-09.why: Decides the 'commit, push' clause: a checkpoint exists on pushed main with no local-only obligation — no merge, rebase, cherry-pick or bisect in progress and no work that lives only on this machine. Whether each tracker item is still verified open is not decided by it.

RUNTIME-001.name: tests/test_runtime_health_contract.py
RUNTIME-001.why: Decides 'without aggregate false health': the contract fails closed on a critical liveness failure or a missing liveness method, refuses to report a shutting-down runtime healthy, separates degraded from failed, fails the required-probe summary on an unhealthy scheduler, tool governance or unready router, and rejects deferred inference as healthy.

RUNTIME-001.name: tests/test_conditions_and_escalation_cap.py
RUNTIME-001.why: Decides the typed conditions the requirement names: Ready, Progressing and Degraded with reasons and transition times, published by the reconciler. Proof and certification conditions are not decided by it.

ACCESSIBILITY-I18N-001.name: ui-audit
ACCESSIBILITY-I18N-001.why: Decides the automated half for every page the interface serves: contrast against every backdrop in the system's light and dark appearance and in every shell theme and accent, screen-reader names and heading structure, keyboard focus that is visible on every control Tab reaches, reduced motion honoured by keyframes and canvases alike, and reflow at 320 CSS pixels, which is a 1280-pixel window at 400% zoom. tests/test_the_interface_audit_can_fail.py holds that each of those can fail. Focus order, VoiceOver itself, captions, locale formatting, bidirectional text and translated strings are not decided by it.

MATRIX-14.name: ui-audit
MATRIX-14.why: Decides the accessibility and viewport clauses for every page the interface serves: inaccessible interactions (contrast on every backdrop, names on every control, a visible focus on every control Tab reaches), and desktop and constrained viewports down to 320 CSS pixels with no horizontal overflow, in each theme and accent. Live-data traceability, loading, empty and degraded states, and screenshot assertions are not decided by it.

PASSF-11.name: ui-audit
PASSF-11.why: Decides responsive states and keyboard behaviour for the shell, memory UI, mission control, telemetry, first-run and controls pages it names, each measured at three widths, in both appearances and every theme. Error-banner wording, loading states and long-text handling are not decided by it.

PASSF-13.name: lint
PASSF-13.why: Decides the 'ruff' part of the fast checks: syntax errors everywhere, the critical F-codes, and the curated files.

PASSF-13.name: compile
PASSF-13.why: Decides the 'py_compile' part of the fast checks over core and tests. The live and end checks the requirement also names are not decided by either.

CTX2-GRAPH-003.name: reachability
CTX2-GRAPH-003.why: Decides 'causal edges that exist only in tests' at module level: the gate fails when a module comes to be imported by tests and nothing else, and every such module carries a recorded disposition. Stale reads, write/write conflicts, circular derivation and shadow copies are not decided by it.

FOREGROUND-LATENCY-001.name: tests/test_async_write_lane_ratchet.py
FOREGROUND-LATENCY-001.why: Decides 'move blocking work off-loop' for the class behind every recorded live loop wedge: a synchronous gateway or atomic write inside an async function, directly or through a same-file helper, fails it unless it is a frozen historical offender. Other blocking owners and the live availability proof are not decided by it.

CTX2-TEST-001.name: tests/test_resource_observation_hermeticity.py
CTX2-TEST-001.why: Decides the injection clause: a simulated observer attributes every dimension the requirement names (RAM, process size, thermal, disk, accelerator, process table), the lane and pressure decisions come out the same under host API failure, reordering and threads, and a legacy facade never reaches the sabotaged host APIs. It does not decide that every test in the tree asks for the injected observer rather than the host.

CTX2-TEST-001.name: tests/test_the_body_reads_the_host_the_turn_declared.py
CTX2-TEST-001.why: Decides the same clause for the subject-core measurements: a busy machine does not reach a calm turn, and everything that reads the host through psutil sees the run's declared host instead.

IIT-SYSTEM-001.name: tests/test_the_carrier_is_measured_not_assumed.py
IIT-SYSTEM-001.why: Decides the whole-runtime integration program's exhaustive-versus-heuristic labelling and its controls: ten domains make 511 cuts and none is excluded, one undecided cut refuses the conjunction, a screened sweep never reads as irreducible and says how many cuts it skipped, the sham floor is subtracted, the playback null collapses, duplicating channels does not raise the rate, and the verdict is never the word conscious. It does not decide the abstraction-error bounds, the branch-and-bound certificate, the treewidth work or the independent implementation.

IIT-SYSTEM-001.name: tests/test_two_identical_samples_read_as_one.py
IIT-SYSTEM-001.why: Decides that the sham control measures nothing on identical laws: arms forked from one anchor are cross-fitted by anchor, two identical samples read exactly zero at every anchor count, and a real difference is still decided. Without it every paired comparison of the program carried a floor of its own estimator.

PASSF-04.name: tests/test_fmea_registry.py
PASSF-04.why: Decides that the repo-native registry exists and cannot rot: every entry carries its subsystem, mode, cause, effect, detection, mitigation, blast radius and severity; each cites an occurrence or says why the mode is reachable; every detection and mitigation module it names still imports; catastrophic and critical modes have a detection; the gaps are pinned and can only shrink; and the rendered doc matches the code. It does not decide an owner or live-proof status per entry, or that each entry names the gate that prevents it.

RR-01.name: tests/test_reality_reach.py
RR-01.why: Decides the contract clauses it attacks: the RealityIR digest is canonical and moves with its input; missing channels produce an explicit unreachable certificate; a sensor floor is partial, never direct; a shared reference cannot establish an external effect; an internal channel cannot be relabelled as direct reality; an ambient claim needs validated coupling and external metrology; required evidence is not inferred from intent; a tampered certificate digest is refused; a control contract needs an actuator and an observation channel. It does not decide alternative-route semantics.

CTX2-GRAPH-001.name: tests/test_who_owns_each_field.py
CTX2-GRAPH-001.why: Decides the canonical-owner column of the catalog: every durable field is found and counted once, a field owned by a phase or written by one module names it, an unowned field says so rather than naming a guess, no owned field becomes unowned, and the unowned count only goes down. It does not decide observers, clocks, freshness budgets, conflict rules, persistence, restart or model-swap behaviour, privacy class or migration.

STATE-001.name: tests/test_who_owns_each_field.py
STATE-001.why: Decides writer authority in the catalog: each durable field has one owner or is counted as having none, and the count of fields with none only goes down. Freshness, arbitration, persistence, model-swap semantics, redaction and action-to-learning traces are not decided by it.

OBSERVE-001.name: tests/test_logging_integrity.py
OBSERVE-001.why: Decides structured logs: every record through the file sink is one parseable JSON object, third-party stdlib records included, and redaction applies on every sink path.

OBSERVE-001.name: tests/test_severity_survives_the_fault_registry.py
OBSERVE-001.why: Decides one property of the crash taxonomy: every severity the runtime emits maps to a fault class, an ordinary one is not promoted to marginal, and an unknown one still defaults to marginal. Traces, receipt correlation, incident export and replay are not decided here.

PRIVACY-001.name: tests/test_logging_integrity.py
PRIVACY-001.why: Decides redaction before persistence for logs: the JSON file sink redacts stdlib records and structlog payload values alike, and a test run writes to its own log directory, never the live one. Every other surface the requirement names is not decided by it.

TEST-DEPTH-001.name: tests/test_resource_observation_hermeticity.py
TEST-DEPTH-001.why: Decides test hermeticity for host resources: an injected simulated observer answers every dimension the runtime reads, decisions come out the same under host API failure, reordering and threads, and a legacy facade never reaches the host. Fuzzing, mutation testing, fault injection and flake accounting are not decided by it.

PASSF-09.name: tests/test_scaffolding_is_not_evidence.py
PASSF-09.why: Decides one runner-specific shortcut: a fixed prefix that already contains every required term cannot pass the operator-evidence contract on its own, on the normal lane or the cancellation lane, so the model's continuation has to carry the claim. Fixture leakage, stale artifacts and the audit surfaces are not decided by it.

MATRIX-02.name: tests/test_the_interventional_line_runs_to_its_preregistered_design.py
MATRIX-02.why: Decides the controls for the integration criterion: one undecided cut of 511 refuses the claim, a playback control decided at any cut or a null that passes the rest and is decided everywhere refuses the null line, a sweep not run to the preregistered design does not count, and the deciding horizon rests on a schedule fact the test holds.

MATRIX-02.name: tests/test_a_claim_cannot_outrun_its_measurement.py
MATRIX-02.why: Decides the clause that she cannot claim more than the evidence supports, for registered claims: a statement in phenomenal language cannot be registered above functional-only evidence, in word or phrase form. The other criteria the requirement lists are not decided by it.

HEALTH-SURFACE-001.name: tests/test_health_read_model.py
HEALTH-SURFACE-001.why: Decides the read-model clauses it names as source-green: single-flight refresh ownership (a blocked collector is never joined and one worker is kept), explicit expiry truth (an old success is marked expired while a refresh is in flight), incident coalescing with one reported recovery, and shutdown truth applied to a cached success on the public route. UI timers, client backoff and the live 30/30 poll proof are not decided by it.

CARRYOVER-02.name: tests/test_runtime_health_contract.py
CARRYOVER-02.why: Decides 'no false health': the contract fails closed on a critical liveness failure or a missing liveness method, refuses to report a shutting-down runtime healthy, and separates degraded from failed. Memory and thermal bounds, crash taxonomy, rollback and failure injection are not decided by it.

IIT-BASELINE-INTEGRITY-001.name: tests/test_whole_system_phi_live_artifact.py
IIT-BASELINE-INTEGRITY-001.why: Decides the clauses about naming what the artifact measured: an organ_host report must say it is not the full live mind and name the 32B cortex it left out; a positive verdict needs enough surrogates for its p to be resolvable, where 20 gives a floor of 0.048; a run whose every interventional row was rejected at projection fails; the report must say the Gaussian rail reads no interventions; and the live_api mode carries a zero-intervention contract, so it cannot pass as a causal run. It does not decide the candidate, observed and retained channel counts, the regenerated replay at adequate power, or the exact-app protocol that replaces live_api.

IIT-STATISTICS-001.name: tests/test_the_interventional_line_runs_to_its_preregistered_design.py
IIT-STATISTICS-001.why: Decides the pinning and sequential-stopping clauses for the interventional line: the looks are fixed before a run and the level is divided among them, a sweep at any other design does not count, the design's fingerprint moves when any part of it does, and the line passes only when all 511 cuts are decided, an intersection whose error is bounded by one cut's level with no correction across cuts. It does not decide power or sample-size calculations, equivalence margins, competitor bounds, or uncertainty from run to run across seeds.

IIT-STATISTICS-001.name: tests/test_a_cut_is_read_by_where_it_moved_her.py
IIT-STATISTICS-001.why: Decides the estimand for one cut: identical arms read nothing, a real displacement is decided at 32 anchors, a cut arm that is only another fork is decided at no more than the level, and rewriting the state in other coordinates changes nothing. The lower bound is a bootstrap over anchors, so dependence within an anchor is kept.

IIT-COMPLEX-001.name: tests/test_the_carrier_is_measured_not_assumed.py
IIT-COMPLEX-001.why: Decides the exclusion clauses over overlapping candidates of the declared domains: a candidate dominated by an overlapping one leaves the frontier, disjoint candidates do not exclude each other, two spectra that cross are both kept rather than a tie being broken, an open or feedforward candidate is no carrier however large its rate, and a screened sweep never reads as irreducible and says how many cuts it skipped, which is the restricted conclusion an incomplete search earns. It does not decide spatial, temporal or discretization grains as candidates, certified pruning bounds, near-tie sensitivity, or recursive condensation.

MQ-18.name: tests/test_an_unsupported_claim_costs_a_sentence_not_the_reply.py
MQ-18.why: Decides the false-positive case for her own operating condition: a sentence claiming a condition nothing measured, such as that everything is running smoothly, is cut from the reply and nothing is left of it, while the measured answer beside it and a grounded reply stay exactly as written.

MQ-18.name: tests/test_a_claim_cannot_outrun_its_measurement.py
MQ-18.why: Decides the experience family at the registry: a statement in phenomenal language cannot be registered above functional-only evidence, in word or phrase form, and its functional restatement can. It records neither answer to whether a state is felt as measured.

MQ-18.name: tests/test_quoted_output_needs_an_executor.py
MQ-18.why: Decides the causality and authorship family for results: output quoted as the result of a run is unfounded unless an executor that could have produced it left a receipt, and a receipt from an unrelated tool cannot vouch for it. None of the three decides the identity, location, continuity or preference families, or that an abstention names the evidence that would resolve it.

SM-04-INTROSPECTION.name: tests/test_self_condition_projection.py
SM-04-INTROSPECTION.why: Decides the freshness and unknown clauses of the projection: fresh inner state is taken before host pressure, a stale dimension is disclosed as stale rather than spoken as current, evidence about agency alone does not become wellbeing, and with no inner evidence the answer says it is unavailable. It does not decide the split between observed, remembered, inferred and counterfactual state, or how disagreement between telemetry, memory and language is resolved.

SM-05-AUTHORSHIP.name: tests/test_effect_claim_closure.py
SM-05-AUTHORSHIP.why: Decides the floor of the chain for actions: every capability she has carries an effect recogniser that fires on a real phrasing of it, a claim to have done something with no receipt is corrected for every action, and a claim with a verified receipt is left alone. It does not decide the join of intention, alternatives, governance and consequence into one ledger, or the grades between assistance, veto, accident and common cause.

SM-06-PREFERENCE-OWNERSHIP.name: tests/test_individual_preferences.py
SM-06-PREFERENCE-OWNERSHIP.why: Decides her preference told apart from a request and a suggestion, and its evidence-governed revision: being told she likes something does not make it hers, a suggestion never counts toward forming one, her own repeated contact does, one contrary encounter does not flip a held preference, accumulated contrary evidence revises it, and the revision records why. It does not decide the typed owner, origin and confidence fields, or preferences told apart from standing obligations, transient affect and model priors.

SM-07-CONTINUITY.name: tests/test_continuity_relation.py
SM-07-CONTINUITY.why: Decides the lineage clauses: continuity is decided by lineage and not by likeness, so a restored backup is not her however well it matches, an instantaneous replacement breaks the chain where a gradual one does not, two chains ending in the same bytes are different cases, and a fork gives two of her with neither continuing the other. It does not decide continuity across sleep, restart, update or memory compaction in a running instance, or how a discontinuity is reported to a person.

MQ-17.name: tests/test_egress_privacy.py
MQ-17.why: Decides least disclosure at the outbound boundary, where a model or tool request is the control the requirement names: secrets and credentials never reach a third party, in a body or in a key however deeply nested, personal identifiers are held back from a model, the owner may turn the personal tier off but never the credential tier, a body the filter cannot read does not reach a model provider, and the receipt never quotes what it caught. CTX2-AMP-003.name: tests/test_phase_response_amplifier_wiring.py::test_phase_keeps_draft_when_amplified_unverified

AMPLIFY-001.name: tests/test_a_verifier_names_what_happened.py

AMPLIFY-001.name: tests/test_verifier_crash_is_not_a_pass.py

AMPLIFY-001.name: tests/test_the_amplifier_reaches_a_typed_turn.py

ACCOUNT-AUTHORITY-001.name: tests/test_her_replies_to_mail.py
ACCOUNT-AUTHORITY-001.why: Decides the email send scope against its exact standing policy: a reply to someone other than the owner is held as a draft and sent only by him until he sets the standing permission, a reply her assessor does not pass is never held for sending, a withdrawn draft answers nothing, and the owner's mail is answered under his principal and a stranger's under none.

ACCOUNT-AUTHORITY-001.name: tests/test_standing_authority.py
ACCOUNT-AUTHORITY-001.why: Decides the standing-authority half every account adapter is held to: leases bound to origin, effect and tool, forged or substituted scopes and argument origins rejected, scope expansion refused, a consequence budget that is atomic and survives a restart, and revocation that is durable, immediate and owner-authenticated.

ACCOUNT-AUTHORITY-001.name: tests/test_an_email_with_no_credentials_is_not_checked.py
ACCOUNT-AUTHORITY-001.why: A missing grant is told apart from a failure: with no credentials the inbox is not called, an unreadable keychain reads as not configured, and a skill not set up says so at info rather than as an adapter error.

ACCOUNT-AUTHORITY-001.name: tests/test_she_is_asked_into_her_mail.py
ACCOUNT-AUTHORITY-001.why: The requested read path: asking her into her mail raises the turn's ceiling to her mail and nothing wider, talk about mail does not, and her accounts ask authority under the turn's origin rather than the tool loop's. Not decided here or above: separate modify, move and delete scopes for email, duplicate-send idempotency, offline and re-authentication, revocation racing a send in flight, the desktop rendering the true disposition, and exact-app effect receipts.

CTX2-ID-001.name: tests/test_continuity_branches_and_identity_does_not.py
CTX2-ID-001.why: Decides the separation and the lineage: bookkeeping is not part of the person and an identity-bearing field is; a migration or a destructive restore with one successor continues her, a fork has no strict successor, a stale backup is a branch from the older stage, and a transfer that did not preserve the person is not continuation.

CTX2-ID-001.name: tests/test_a_person_who_learns_is_still_herself.py
CTX2-ID-001.why: Signed identity transitions: a change written by a measured transformation inside its contract continues her, an unmeasured change ends continuity, the writes sit under the signature, the key is the install's own and not one in the source, and two installs sign the same lineage differently.

CTX2-ID-001.name: tests/test_a_shutdown_snapshot_continues_her_line.py
CTX2-ID-001.why: A snapshot continues her durable line or is not written: a stale one is refused, one whose parent never arrived follows the latest stage, and the first of an empty log is written.

CTX2-ID-001.name: tests/test_cortex_generation_upgrade.py
CTX2-ID-001.why: The replaceable weights: a model migration is staged with a byte-exact rollback and changes nothing live, activation needs operator authorization and a passing verdict, and rollback restores the pointer exactly. Not decided here or above: a schema check of the identity snapshot carried across a model swap, and identity kept apart from the prompts her model is given.

CTX2-MIND-002.name: tests/test_state_ownership.py
CTX2-MIND-002.why: Decides the boot-scoped identity and its first carriers: one runtime instance id, immutable for the process and naming its profile, so a test run can never pass as the live runtime; persistent records are stamped with the runtime that wrote them, a forwarded record keeps its origin, and the identity serialises without secrets.

CTX2-MIND-002.name: tests/test_governance_reaches_the_health_surface.py::test_the_health_surface_names_the_runtime_that_is_reporting
CTX2-MIND-002.why: The health report names the runtime instance that produced it.

CTX2-MIND-002.name: tests/test_release_certificate.py::test_the_certificate_names_the_runtime_that_built_it
CTX2-MIND-002.why: A proof artifact names the runtime instance that built it.

CTX2-MIND-002.name: tests/test_a_shutdown_snapshot_continues_her_line.py
CTX2-MIND-002.why: The durable lineage: a snapshot continues her one line or is not written. Not decided here or above: the instance and lineage ids carried through mind moments, chat turns, plans, actions, welfare changes, model calls and turn receipts, and shown in the operator interface.

CARRYOVER-03.name: tests/test_server_conversation_lane.py::test_api_chat_desktop_surface_requires_cognitive_engine_and_blocks_kernel_fallback
CARRYOVER-03.why: No raw model takeover on the desktop surface: a desktop turn requires the CognitiveEngine and the kernel fallback is blocked.

CARRYOVER-03.name: tests/test_server_conversation_lane.py::test_api_chat_refuses_implicit_legacy_orchestrator_fallback
CARRYOVER-03.why: No assistant fallback: the legacy orchestrator answers only when explicitly asked for, never as a silent substitute.

CARRYOVER-03.name: tests/test_server_conversation_lane.py::test_api_chat_desktop_surface_outer_timeout_refuses_direct_gate_fallback
CARRYOVER-03.why: A desktop turn that runs out of time is not handed to the raw gate to answer instead.

CARRYOVER-03.name: tests/test_ungrounded_person_gate.py
CARRYOVER-03.why: No name hallucination: a person named on the conversation surface with nothing grounding them is caught, from the live transcript where she invented Peter Brenner and called the user Aaron.

CARRYOVER-03.name: tests/test_ui_is_not_invisible_by_default.py
CARRYOVER-03.why: No black panels: no content depends on a CSS animation having run to be visible.

CARRYOVER-03.name: tests/test_a_capture_without_the_grant_is_not_attempted.py
CARRYOVER-03.why: No repeated TCC prompts: a screen capture macOS would refuse is not attempted, so macOS does not ask again (43 dialogs in ten minutes on 3 November).

CARRYOVER-03.name: tests/test_one_resident_runtime_at_a_time.py
CARRYOVER-03.why: No model-spawn runaway: a second process may not load a second cortex beside the first. Not decided here or above: the same proven in the launched Aura.app itself, context drift into invented projects, and desktop-control false negatives.

CTX2-PERSON-002.name: tests/test_interpersonal_model.py
CTX2-PERSON-002.why: Decides the relationship-memory distinctions the requirement names: what he said, what she saw and what she inferred are kept apart and an inference says it is one; a correction removes a claim and no later observation revives it; shared events are recorded without a frequency and never decay; commitments, ruptures with whether they were repaired, and open questions are first-class; knowledge about her is kept apart from knowledge about him; and every reading carries the evidence that produced it.

CTX2-PERSON-002.name: tests/test_interpersonal_persistence.py
CTX2-PERSON-002.why: The distinctions survive a restart: every field round-trips, evidence is not restamped as new, a correction and a repaired rupture stay as they were, and a conditional keeps its condition.

CTX2-PERSON-002.name: tests/test_relational_memory_authority.py
CTX2-PERSON-002.why: Consent and privacy: a record is session-only without the person's explicit consent, consent is exact to the agent, expiring and purpose-scoped, the stored envelope holds no identity or memory in plain text, revocation blocks use, and deletion and export need authorization receipts and leave other people's records intact.

CTX2-PERSON-002.name: tests/test_asking_to_be_forgotten_is_never_silent.py
CTX2-PERSON-002.why: User-controllable deletion: an ordinary request to be forgotten is recognised, a negated one never deletes, and an unhonoured request is counted where her integrity report shows it.

CTX2-PERSON-002.name: tests/test_one_door_into_what_she_knows_about_people.py
CTX2-PERSON-002.why: Each person is their own record: two people do not shadow each other, and every turn reaches the record through one door. Not decided here or above: non-instrumental welfare for the people she models, and boundaries she keeps on their behalf beyond consent.

CTX2-WELFARE-001.name: tests/test_the_valence_is_the_only_path.py
CTX2-WELFARE-001.why: Decides the arbitration: every damage and benefit channel reaches policy through the one appraisal, no policy term reads a raw input, a lesioned valence leaves no policy shift behind, and an unknown axis is refused rather than ignored.

CTX2-WELFARE-001.name: tests/test_welfare_model.py
CTX2-WELFARE-001.why: The welfare authority's source and reach: interests derive from real telemetry and are bounded, only a vital interest's deficit gates optional work, background policy consumes that gate, the gate holds when a snapshot fails, and what she reports of her condition is what the welfare model holds.

CTX2-WELFARE-001.name: tests/test_nociception.py
CTX2-WELFARE-001.why: Nociception with decay: damage raises pressure, pain decays over time, repeated failures escalate, valence is negative while deteriorating and positive while healing, and recorded degradations feed it live.

CTX2-WELFARE-001.name: tests/test_a_feeling_named_is_what_moved_her.py
CTX2-WELFARE-001.why: Explicit source: a feeling she is shown to have is one something moved, read from its departure from her resting chemistry. Not decided here or above: resistance to a prompt that tries to set her welfare signals, attachment and existential-stakes signals under the same authority, and per-signal confidence and persistence across restarts.

TOOLS-001.name: tests/test_durable_workflow_approval.py
TOOLS-001.why: Resumable and budgeted: a paused workflow resumes past its approval without re-running the completed prefix, the decision survives a new engine process, a denial cancels and records who refused, a cancelled workflow owes no more work, and a step retries only up to its policy.

TOOLS-001.name: tests/test_reality_reach_transactions.py
TOOLS-001.why: Idempotent and compensating effects: a verified effect is durable and replays idempotently, a failed independent verification rolls back, a crash after dispatch is never replayed automatically, restart recovery returns an interrupted effect to an observed safe state, and drift in what the provider offers is refused before any effect.

TOOLS-001.name: tests/test_procedure_steps_need_their_own_evidence.py
TOOLS-001.why: Complete only after observed effects: a step advances on its own requirement's observed effect, a later answer does not prove an earlier requirement, and a causal change does not complete a planned effect before it is observed.

TOOLS-001.name: tests/test_the_tool_loop_sees_what_was_read.py
TOOLS-001.why: Source preserving: what the turn already read reaches the tool loop, so a named document is not fetched again from a rebuilt URL. Not decided here or above: one typed workflow spanning many tools end to end, and a tool renamed or replaced by its provider mid-workflow.

CTX2-COLLEAGUE-003.name: tests/test_interpersonal_persistence.py
CTX2-COLLEAGUE-003.why: Relationships through a restart: every field of what she knows about a person round-trips, corrections and repaired ruptures stay as they were, evidence is not restamped as new, and an unreadable file is an incident with the evidence kept rather than an empty model.

CTX2-COLLEAGUE-003.name: tests/test_standing_authority.py::test_budget_is_atomic_and_survives_manager_restart
CTX2-COLLEAGUE-003.why: Permissions through a restart: a consequence budget is atomic and survives the manager restarting.

CTX2-COLLEAGUE-003.name: tests/test_standing_authority.py::test_revocation_is_durable_immediate_and_owner_authenticated
CTX2-COLLEAGUE-003.why: Permission drift: a revocation is durable and immediate, and only the owner can make it.

CTX2-COLLEAGUE-003.name: tests/test_reality_reach_transactions.py
CTX2-COLLEAGUE-003.why: Partial external effects through a crash: an effect dispatched before a crash is never replayed automatically, a new coordinator returns an interrupted effect to an observed safe state, and a failed recovery is reported as indeterminate.

CTX2-COLLEAGUE-003.name: tests/test_durable_workflow_approval.py::test_the_decision_survives_a_new_engine_process
CTX2-COLLEAGUE-003.why: Operator intervention through a restart: an approval decision survives a new engine process.

CTX2-COLLEAGUE-003.name: tests/test_a_goal_is_one_object.py
CTX2-COLLEAGUE-003.why: Obligations: a goal she forms reaches its durable store, and one that could not be made durable says so rather than being reported as kept.

CTX2-COLLEAGUE-003.name: tests/test_a_shutdown_snapshot_continues_her_line.py
CTX2-COLLEAGUE-003.why: Identity through shutdown: a snapshot continues her one line or is not written. Not decided here or above: project state across an update, the same through a model migration live, and behaviour under network loss.

RLC-BASELINES-001.name: tests/test_fitted_controls_are_compared_as_pairs.py
RLC-BASELINES-001.why: Decides the rule against a straw baseline: a greater total win count does not establish superiority to a matched control; the arms are compared as pairs on the same items.

RLC-BASELINES-001.name: tests/test_sequential_exclusion_dominates_iid.py
RLC-BASELINES-001.why: The best-of-N control as arithmetic: verifier-guided exclusion is checked against i.i.d. best-of-N for every N and distribution, and a flat pilot is predicted to gain little rather than oversold.

RLC-BASELINES-001.name: tests/test_latent_cortex_budget_reconciliation.py
RLC-BASELINES-001.why: Equal compute is enforceable: a compute receipt is checked against what was allocated, so an arm cannot spend past its budget and still pass, and a missing or exhausted receipt is refused.

RLC-BASELINES-001.name: tests/test_rlc_reconciliation_sweep.py::test_the_mechanism_arm_stays_an_ablation
RLC-BASELINES-001.why: The mechanism arm is kept an ablation and never reported as the unified system.

RLC-BASELINES-001.name: tests/test_g09_organ_harness.py
RLC-BASELINES-001.why: The single-sample control her reasoning organ is measured against: the same sealed tasks, sampled reproducibly with exclusions, graded by each source's published grader for both arms. Not decided here or above: vanilla resident, longer-CoT, equal-FLOP and equal-latency arms run with identical prompt information, cache state, task order and output limits.

AUTONOMY-001.name: tests/test_a_goal_nobody_wrote_can_reach_her.py
AUTONOMY-001.why: Self-directed goal formation: a goal she works out herself, from initiatives her own boredom, curiosity, social hunger and load decide to propose, reaches her rather than stopping at the trigger.

AUTONOMY-001.name: tests/test_a_prompt_fragment_is_not_a_goal.py
AUTONOMY-001.why: Not a prompt phrase: an instruction written for a model is never taken for something she wants.

AUTONOMY-001.name: tests/test_a_thought_she_had_on_her_own_can_reach_the_will.py
AUTONOMY-001.why: Bounded action without being commanded: a thought she had on her own reaches the intent router and the Will, from trusted internal sources only, and a router failure is reported rather than swallowed.

AUTONOMY-001.name: tests/test_her_own_yes_asks_the_gates.py
AUTONOMY-001.why: Consequence-governed without approval theatre: her own yes to a change of hers runs the gates in her workspace and stops at the first that fails, handing her its words.

AUTONOMY-001.name: tests/test_a_standing_grant_is_scoped_and_spent.py
AUTONOMY-001.why: No silent authority minting: a standing grant moves a decision earlier and makes it narrower, and is scoped and spent.

AUTONOMY-001.name: tests/test_a_deferral_is_not_a_refusal.py
AUTONOMY-001.why: Deferring for reasons of her own is told apart from being refused. Not decided here or above: a live proof that she understands her available action surfaces and chooses among them uncommanded, reflection and communication she starts herself, and that no state turns autonomous action off.

CTX2-REPL-001.name: tests/test_adjudicate_unified_intrinsic_resident_replication.py
CTX2-REPL-001.why: Decides what counts as a replication: a powered plan frozen before it runs, three disjoint seeds, any task or prompt reused across seeds rejected, and an evaluator that drifts between seeds rejected.

CTX2-REPL-001.name: tests/test_campaign_role_signer_service.py
CTX2-REPL-001.why: Separate artifact signers: each campaign role signs with its own isolated key, which never touches disk and signs only a sealed policy.

CTX2-REPL-001.name: tests/test_g05_independent_verifier.py
CTX2-REPL-001.why: Separate evaluators: G05's reading of her final answer is written apart from the runner that produced it.

CTX2-REPL-001.name: tests/test_g04_independent_verifier.py
CTX2-REPL-001.why: The same separation for G08's verifier, which interprets and tests with its own code. Not decided here or above: an independent replication of any of the named results: canonical-instance ownership, substrate and welfare effects on behaviour, amplifier uplift, one-shot learning, continuity through a model migration, tool-effect completion, rollback, and long-horizon recovery.

CODING-001.name: tests/test_self_repair_needs_a_fault_in_her_code.py
CODING-001.why: From failing evidence to root cause: a self-repair turn starts only on evidence of a fault her code can be changed to fix and names where it is; a bound that held, a reply that would not parse, a log line with no traceback, or a traceback only through libraries is not one.

CODING-001.name: tests/test_repair_loop_wild.py
CODING-001.why: The loop end to end on real low-risk bugs: a bug packet, a test written for it, a patch, validation, lineage recorded, and a rollback that is available and proven by reverting the mutation.

CODING-001.name: tests/test_her_own_yes_asks_the_gates.py
CODING-001.why: Review and validation before commit: her yes to a draft of hers runs the tests naming each module she changed, smoke, lint, layering and the writing gate, stops at the first that fails, and keeps what each said with the merge.

CODING-001.name: tests/test_promotion_governor_cp126.py
CODING-001.why: The gate that writes into live source: a promotion is decided against its proof and its rollback packet.

CODING-001.name: tests/test_autonomous_repair_executor.py
CODING-001.why: Monitoring and dedupe: a fault is logged and runs a repair cycle, a repeated fault waits out its cooldown, and an environmental fault never becomes a source repair. Not decided here or above: coding at a human-level-plus standard on unseen repositories, learning carried from one repair to the next, and one repair of hers taken through this loop into the source she runs on.

RLC-CONSOLIDATION-001.name: tests/test_latent_consolidation.py
RLC-CONSOLIDATION-001.why: Decides the loop from candidate to rollback on real machinery: an exported episode lands a candidate in the queue, the trusted consumer validates its evidence and refuses corrupt, unproven or fingerprint-less candidates, a domain proposes only after enough independent wins, proposals are scoped to one checkpoint, distillation is the exact mean delta and refuses mixed fingerprints or dimensions, a missing or incomplete held-out contract refuses activation, a held-out regression blocks it, and a full train activates an adapter and rolls it back exactly. RLC-ANTI-INTERFERENCE-001.name: tests/test_latent_consolidation.py::test_disruptive_change_fails_battery_and_reverts

RLC-ANTI-INTERFERENCE-001.name: tests/test_latent_consolidation.py::test_identity_change_passes_battery

RLC-ANTI-INTERFERENCE-001.name: tests/test_latent_consolidation.py::test_natural_probes_measure_protected_behavior_regions
RLC-ANTI-INTERFERENCE-001.why: Its probes measure the behaviour regions it protects.

RLC-ANTI-INTERFERENCE-001.name: tests/test_latent_consolidation.py::test_disruptive_adapter_is_refused_and_model_untouched
RLC-ANTI-INTERFERENCE-001.why: A disruptive adapter is refused and the model is left untouched.

RLC-ANTI-INTERFERENCE-001.name: tests/test_latent_consolidation.py::test_heldout_regression_blocks_activation
RLC-ANTI-INTERFERENCE-001.why: A held-out regression blocks activation. Not decided here or above: more domains and seeds, identity, governance, tool and latency probes, adversarial tasks, retained activation windows, longitudinal revalidation, and independent replay.

CARRYOVER-07.name: tests/test_latent_consolidation.py
CARRYOVER-07.why: Behavioural holdouts and no heuristic-only acceptance for adapters: a missing or incomplete held-out contract refuses activation, a held-out regression blocks it, flat loss or no steps is rejected, and the interference battery fails a disruptive change and reverts it.

CARRYOVER-07.name: tests/test_caa_causal_evaluation.py
CARRYOVER-07.why: CAA steering qualified by causal evidence only: an independent replay builds the evaluation, producer scores that were tampered with are rejected, every specificity lesion is required, and a result changed after verification is rejected.

CARRYOVER-07.name: tests/test_amplifier_cache_integrity.py
CARRYOVER-07.why: No cache contamination: work the uncached path verifies is never served from the cache without the same verification.

CARRYOVER-07.name: tests/test_quantization_floor.py
CARRYOVER-07.why: Quantization-aware substrate coupling: how much of a steering vector survives 4-bit weights is measured, so an alpha that steers is told apart from one drowned by quantization noise.

CARRYOVER-07.name: tests/test_reasoning_phi_budget.py
CARRYOVER-07.why: Bounded Phi compute: demand buys reasoning depth and Phi capacity gates how much of it may be spent. Not decided here or above: the CRSM and LoRA debt closed as a whole, active memory metabolism, and a bound on LTC compute.
